body.x: Jabra(www.myinnergie.com) announced Jabra Solemate Max at 'Showstoppers' of 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Jabra Solemate Max is the playful wireless speaker that is completely comfortable in the home but portable and durable enough to venture outside because it is resistant to dust and splash and builds to take the bumps and knocks of any journey. It delivers sound you would expect from a much larger speaker, packing two tweeters, two woofers and a custom-designed bass slave into a lightweight design.

You can also connect this with Bluetooth or NFC and control playlists wirelessly. Solemate Max's battery can be rechargeable and easily go for 14 hours, plus it charges your phone. So whether you’re using Solemate Max for music, movies, games or as a personal speakerphone for calls and video chats – it will be ready.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
